items.title: KittySploit – AI-Powered Next-Generation Penetration Testing Framework With 1150+ Modules
items.description: KittySploit is a new open-source penetration testing framework that combines a Python and Zig codebase with autonomous AI agents, ship­ping with over 1,150 modules for offensive security teams. The tool chain includes reconnaissance, exploitation, traffic analysis, payload generation, collaboration, and post-exploitation workflows.
